intro: Danitha Morr asks you to find Deathguard Falgan in Venomweb Vale. He and a companion uncovered Scarlet orders for an attack on Brill before they were separated.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.
Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.
Please, find my friend and help him if you can.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm... Back? And saved by an adventurer no less? I see you carry a Symbol of Life. I've not seen one of those since... Well, since before the war when Lordaeron was a very different place. I can only assume you are here to help. Billmuth and I were sent here to scout out the scarlet activity here, and we found out that they are planning some kind of attack.
If you would be willing to help more, there may yet be more that you can do to help the Forsaken.
